requirements.statement: Enhanced Fleet Response Segment: Contains data applying to enhanced fleet offerings, returned by the authorization network.
Incomm Market Basket Data (Request) Segment: Contains data required by Incomm transactions containing Market Basket Data.
Incomm Market Basket Data (Response) Segment: Contains data returned from Incomm when the request segment is included.
Network Token Data Request Segment: Contains Network Token Data associated with this transaction.
Start-of-Data Block Indicator: Indicates the start of a data block; fixed value, sourced from Host.
Software Dial Load Data Segment: Contains merchant-specific dial load data; sent only on Software Load Response.
Software IP Load Data Segment: Contains merchant-specific IP/URL address load data; sent only on Software Load Response.
Message Format Version Identifier: Identifies the message format version.
Number of Segments: Identifies the number of BUYPASS-defined segments included in the message, fixed value of 1.
Proprietary Data Load Segment: Indicates that this is a Proprietary Data Load Request.
Number of Segments: Indicates the number of segments in the message; fixed value 01.
CA Public Key File Block Length: Identifies the length of the following field (CA Public Key File), valid values 0000-9999.
CA Public Key File Block: Identifies the new Public Key file or an Error Message, max 9,999 bytes for approved loads.
Block Number: Identifies the specific data block requested by a device or sent by the host.
Reserved: Found only in the segment-transaction matrix (page 216); no matching Chapter 12 segment-definition heading located in raw/pdf_pages.
Reserved: Found only in the segment-transaction matrix (page 216); no matching Chapter 12 segment-definition heading located in raw/pdf_pages.
Fleet Data Segment: Can appear in any field of Data Section 3; included in all fleet card transaction requests.
Fleet Tag 1: Conditional field sent only in Auth Completion message with 3-byte tag and up to 31 bytes data.
Product Code Data Segment: Data Segment No. 102, holds product-level data for Financial Transaction requests.
Purchase Card Data Segment: Data Segment No. 104, max 86 alphanumeric chars, originates at the device, used in Data Section No. 3.
Totals Data Segment: Appears in Field No. 3, Data Section No. 3; max 409 alphanumeric characters; originates at device.
Loyalty Card Data Segment: Appears in Field No. 4, Data Section No. 3; max length 142 alphanumeric characters; originates at device.
Electronic Mail Data Segment: Always in Field No. 3, Data Section No. 2; originates at device.
Check Data Segment: Data Segment No. 110, max length 168 alphanumeric characters, originates at device.
Full MICR Line - TAC Format: MICR format example: T999999999A999999999999999999C999999.
Full MICR Line - Format RAW TOAD: TOAD format is a symbol substitution of MICR characters on the check.
Alternate MICR Indicator: New field in 110-Check Data Segment identifying ALB1/RAW MICR format support, element 239.
Alternate MICR IND: Denotes merchant supports Alternate MICR format; 'Y' indicates alternate MICR format sent.
Variable Information Data Segment: Can appear in any field of Data Section No. 3; originates at the device.
Additional Information Data Segment: Segment 112 carries additional info like balances, AVS/CVV, loyalty, PAR, fraud score, appended at end of Financial Transaction response.
ECA/ TeleCheck Data Segment: Data Segment No. 113 can appear in any field in Data Section No. 3; originates at device.
Denial Record Number: Identifies the record number of the declined ECA/TeleCheck transaction.
Extended MICR Data: Identifies check MICR data when MICR length exceeds 50 bytes.
SKU Data Segment: Appears in Field No. 5 of Data Section No. 3, originates at the device.
Print Data Segment: Sent on Financial Transaction Response messages requiring large amounts of print data.
Proprietary Data Load Segment: Requests or captures customer specific proprietary data for loading at BUYPASS FEP.
Block Number: Identifies the specific block number sent by device or Host for next block determination.
Card Table Data: Data for indicated table type; field length determined by segment length in field 2.
Block Number: Starts at 1, increments per segment of site configuration data sent.

requirements.statement: Totals with Proprietary Data Load Data Segment: Segment No. 119 appears in Field No. 3, Data Section No. 3, requests Totals plus Card Table/Host Discount data.
Card Label: Identifies the card type; sourced from device.
Card Type Total Count: Identifies the transaction count for a particular card type; sourced from device.
Card Type Total Amount: Identifies the total amount for a particular card type; sourced from device.
Print Data 2 Segment: Sent only on Financial Transaction Response messages requiring large amounts of print data.
NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment: Provides info for NFC tokenized transactions; required for tokenized, MasterCard Token, DSRP, or Visa TAVV data.
Cryptogram Token Data: Identifies Merchant's Cryptogram Token data Block A or blocks A and B.
SafeKey Data: Identifies SafeKey cryptogram indicator, AEVV, and AESK transaction identifier.
SafeKey Response: Identifies SafeKey Cryptogram AEVV response value from Authorizer.
TAVV Cryptogram: Merchant's Token Authentication Verification Value cryptogram in base64 for payment token transactions.
